beats.say: Age 13: Barbara Palvin was discovered on Budapest streets.
She was walking with her mother when a scout approached.
She shot her first editorial in 2006 for Spur Magazine, then debuted for Prada in February 2010.
By February 2012 she was a L'Oreal Paris ambassador, and placed fourth in Maxim's Hot 100 in 2016.
On 15 July 2023, she married in Albertirsa, Hungary, in the same church where her parents wed.
The Budapest teenager went from a street discovery to honouring her family roots.
Did you know she returned to her family's church?

facts: Barbara Palvin was born on October 8, 1993, in Budapest, Hungary.
When she was 13, she was discovered on the streets of Budapest by a modeling scout while walking with her mother.
She shot her first editorial in 2006 for Spur Magazine.
Her runway debut was for Prada during Milan Fashion Week in February 2010.
In February 2012, she became an ambassador for L'Oreal Paris.
In 2016, Palvin was ranked 4th in Maxim Hot 100.
On July 15, 2023, the couple married in the town of Albertirsa, Hungary, in the same church that Palvin's parents married.
